scope: Independent visual inspection of the actual single +X orthographic CPU render and its labelled contextual comparison. No additional render, numerical rerun or image modification was performed.

observations.recognition: Individual brick courses, pale mortar, wrapping woody tendrils and curled leaves are clearly recognisable.
observations.colour: Red-brown and grey brick variation and the warm brown/orange foliage distribution are consistent with the contextual reference. No conspicuous unintended global hue shift is visible.
observations.depth: Occlusion, contact shadows and overlapping vines give clear depth around the brick column. Mortar separations and dark recesses remain visible.
observations.transport: The framing and main silhouette agree closely with the reference. No obvious newly missing surface patch, back-face loss or broad colour substitution is visible in this view.
observations.existing_defects: Dark gaps, crowded intersections, ragged leaf edges and thin stray or apparently disconnected strands remain visible in both panels. They are not newly established transport defects.
observations.shading: Some foliage surfaces remain angular or creased. Similar features are visible in the reference; this view does not reveal a conspicuous new shading failure attributable to absent exported normals.

numerical_evidence_boundary: Saved receipts report exact original geometry/material preservation, unchanged native corner bytes, and all112 original quality rows passing on the actual native getter before rendering. Those exact checks support the absence of geometry loss; one image alone cannot prove every hidden face.
presentation: Cycles CPU, OpenImageDenoise with GPU denoising disabled,32 samples,640x640 and labelled +2EV. This presentation setting is not a universal material correction.
warning_review: The preserved stdout warning says CUEW initialization failed while opening an optional library. The actual recorded render device is CPU and GPU denoising is disabled; the warning does not establish GPU rendering.
limits: One +X view at640px. The prior PBR panel uses different source-colour sampling, transfer and material semantics, so comparison is contextual rather than pixel-exact. Hidden surfaces and other views are not visually qualified here.
conclusion: No unacceptable new visible export/import defect was found in this view. Existing generated geometry defects remain; this is not a game-ready or general asset-quality certification.
